canonical_project: Dongara Data Centre at Cliff Head/Arrowsmith
notes: Pilot Energy's ASX release says the first 1MW Dongara Data Centre module at the Cliff Head Plant site was commissioned and commenced operation, with initial 0.4MW computing capacity live and the remaining 0.6MW pending electrical upgrades. A later expansion to 4MW is planned for 2H CY2026, subject to satisfactory operation.
